MANYBODY MOLECULE

* Atom styles:
atomic full hybrid
* Pair styles:
lj/cut eam/alloy hybrid hybrid/overlay hybrid/scaled zero
* Fix styles
nve nvt npt langevin
* Compute styles:
temp temp/com
* Dump styles:
custom atom
* Bond styles:
hybrid harmonic zero
* Angle styles:
hybrid harmonic zero
* Integrate styles:
verlet respa
* Minimize styles:
cg fire
* Region styles:
block sphere
* Command styles
run read_data
